text_block_list.text: Hahaha! ♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My friend has always been by my side, ever since I was a child. Always…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Watching from behind as she runs, I'm reminded of myself…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I've never seen her face. She's always ahead of me. And I can never catch up, no matter how hard I try…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: We talk all the time, but… there's one question I could never bring myself to ask.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Who…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer… good morning.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Let's continue training… So someday, my dream will…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is Manhattan Cafe, my trainee. Her dream is a little on the strange side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In her own words…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I can… see things. Things others can't. Mysterious and wondrous beings…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But… no one would believe me when I told them that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So, when I was still little… I withdrew into my shell… to keep the things important to me out of harm's way.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But one day, I saw a girl running. From behind, she looked very much like me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I couldn't see her face, but she seemed to be having so much fun. I became so… envious… of her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …I want to catch up to her. I want to run with her, side by side.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Do you think I'll be able to catch up to her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'll catch up, and overtake her. That's the promise we made when we sealed our training contract.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't see her friend for myself. But I still chose to believe her and made that contract.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Because I sensed incredible potential in her running ability. And also…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Wait for me, okay? One day… I'll catch up to you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I felt that she was at risk. That without the right support, she would be consumed by a deep darkness…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm mulling over these thoughts, when…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh? I know this voice…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My friend is calling out to me. She's saying… to go this way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, thump, thump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We end up at a racecourse. Perfectly still, Manhattan Cafe gazes at the track.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's her… She's running… and she's in the lead, way out in front…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She's waiting… for me… Do you know how I can enter this race?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Debut… in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And if I finish in first… and keep winning, my friend will be in reach…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Can I, Trainer? I really… really want to enter…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like the time has finally come for Manhattan Cafe to take the stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her friend currently stands at the summit of the Twinkle Series. If Manhattan Cafe can scale that peak too, perhaps true bliss awaits her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, well. If it isn't Cafe and her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, it's you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Striking up a conversation with us is Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's an Umamusume researcher famous throughout the academy for her devotion to the realm of possibility and something of a mad scientist.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her research lab also happens to be an unused classroom she shares with Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The student council initially gave Manhattan Cafe permission to borrow the classroom and use it to store her hobby paraphernalia.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But later on, Agnes Tachyon demanded that the student council give her a laboratory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Deciding that a troublemaker like her needed supervision, they approved her request on the condition that she share the room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how half the classroom came to serve as Agnes Tachyon's research lab.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe continues to use the other half of the room to store her things, with the added caveat of having to watch over Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Can we help you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, why so cold? We have our fair share of commonalities, you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Cafe. Your goal is to pursue an imaginary friend—a difficult goal indeed for any ordinary person to understand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My goal, on the other hand, is to transcend the very limits of Uma-kind. That matters more to me than even victory.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What a strange and peculiar pair we make, wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You don't seem especially pleased about that… but you will be seeing me more and more often.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: We're peers now. Since you've decided to debut in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look over there. That's Agnes Tachyon, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she's planning to debut this year. News is that she's super fast.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …You too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've heard the rumors. They say Agnes Tachyon is extraordinarily gifted, and she produces perfect results no matter what she does.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe might have hidden potential, but for now there's no comparison between her running and Tachyon's.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: See you around, Cafe. Cheers to our future. I'm expecting great things from you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Not the same things as from me, of course.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Not… the same things?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After sharing a few cryptic words, Agnes Tachyon departs. As I ponder their meaning…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Let's not worry about her. We have a more important goal…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Catching up to my friend. Nothing else matters… right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's Manhattan Cafe. She's no ordinary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The dream she's chasing is steeped in mystery, veiled in mist. And I'm going to navigate it with her.
